data.one_liner: Print receipts via ESC/POS thermal WiFi/Ethernet printers
data.what_it_does: This package provides a NetworkPrinter class that connects to ESC/POS thermal printers over WiFi or Ethernet and sends print commands. It supports text, styles, images and basic printer control such as feed and cut.
use_when: You need to print receipts on a networked ESC/POS printer from a Flutter or Dart app
You prefer a simple imperative API without code generation
You are targeting Android, iOS, Windows, macOS or Linux
avoid_when: You require advanced barcode or PDF417 support not yet implemented
strengths: Built on top of esc_pos_utils_plus for styling
weaknesses: Limited feature set (no QR, PDF417, line spacing)
